'''Prava''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] in charge of the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that would come to be known as [[Mek-Sha]], during the [[Galactic War]]. The ongoing [[Conquest of Makeb]] caused Prava to be distracted regarding his own operation which prompted the [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Huttbreaker|Gritha Dar]] to persuade others to join her cause and [[Huttbreaker's Rebellion|steal]] the station's control from the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]].<ref name="Codex" />
